attestations.note: The page heads him «(; - 1792)» and dates the martyrdom to the hour: «Όλα αυτά έγιναν στη Χίο, στις 15 Μαρτίου 1792 μ.Χ., ήμερα Δευτέρα και ώρα τέσσερις μ.μ.» — at Chios, on 15 March 1792, a Monday, at four in the afternoon, which is the day the calendar keeps him on. It says the Turks bound his body with boulders and threw it into the sea, and that a manuscript of his martyrdom is in the library of the monastery of Xenophon on the Holy Mountain. It prints no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).
